name: Sexy Valentine 🍆 💜
source:
Sexy Valentine 🍆 💜 is a short adult Visual Novel focusing on the romantic parts of life. The protagonist was left without plans and friends for Valentine's Day, and decided to use a dating app. After choosing several similarly lonely guys, he makes a date with them.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2292590]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《Sexy Valentine🍆💜》是一部聚焦生活中浪漫一面的成人短篇视觉小说。情人节当天，主角既没有安排，也没有朋友相伴，于是决定使用约会软件。他挑选了几位同样孤独的男士，与他们约好见面。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2292590]Steam[/url]]
